_comment: Hoenn & Seek 2.1-02: radio segments. Read by tools/hoenn/gen_hoenn_radio.py, which writes
src/data/hoenn_radio_segments.h (the table src/hoenn_radio.c reads). Design: src/hoenn_radio.c.
segments: played in front of a station's normal broadcast, in this order, when their
conditions hold and they fit (15 lines and 8 text buffers per broadcast; a segment that
doesn't fit whole is skipped). On OAK's POKéMON TALK they play in the intro, after MARY.
key: unique name (letters, digits, _). station: oak, pokedex, music, lucky, buena, unown,
places, sing, rocket, hoenn_sound. if: the hint engine's conditions (npc_hints.json's
text: a string or a list of strings, word-wrapped into radio lines (at most 8), or
native: a C builder (HoennRadioBuilder, include/hoenn_radio.h) with lines: the most it
writes and buffers: the text buffers it uses.
2.1-05 adds 'heard' (a Seeker's Journal rumor the segment marks as heard).

segments._note: 2.0 part 28: the cipher's signal at the Ruins of Alph (src/hoenn_lane_a.c)
2.0 part 35b: where the uncaught beast was last tracked (src/hoenn_johto_legends.c)
